note: Original sample transcript written for TribeCode's tests (CC0).

lines.text: Okay, let's start. The boss fight is the main thing today.
Playtesters said the boss is too hard on the first try. Most people died in under a minute.
I think the problem is the second attack. It has no warning sound, so you can't dodge it.
Right. We decided the boss gets two phases instead of three, and the second attack gets a wind-up.
I'll record a creak sound for the wind-up tonight.
Sam will tune the boss health down by twenty percent.
Also the checkpoint before the boss room is missing, which makes every death cost five minutes.
We need to add a checkpoint flag right before the boss door.
Cool. Playtest again on Friday evening with the same three friends.

summary: The boss is too hard because the second attack has no warning.
The team decided on two boss phases and a wind-up for the second attack.
A checkpoint before the boss door is missing.
actions: Maya: record a creak sound for the wind-up
Sam: tune the boss health down by twenty percent
add a checkpoint flag right before the boss door
decisions: the boss gets two phases instead of three
